description: Rehnuma Parveen used IESVE to calibrate an apartment model in a study of residential energy independence. The provider summary compares simulated indoor temperatures and electricity consumption with measured observations. It reports CV(RMSE) values of 1.37% for hourly indoor air temperature and 7.42% for monthly electricity consumption. The account describes calibration as the basis for further energy-independence assessment. Adelaide identifies the researcher affiliation or listing location; the apartment location is not established. Source-reported calibration metrics are retained without adopting its general acceptability-threshold claim. This public HTML case narrative is published by IES and can be read without payment. Its reuse licence is not stated. Access to the described software, input data and project models is not established by the public page. The source does not give a complete study period or all spatial and temporal model resolutions. Reported results are provider claims and have not been independently reproduced. The case supports the documented infrastructure simulation use and is linked to the named modelling resources. Only metadata and the case description were inspected; no data or model files were downloaded.
